label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Desde palabra de mentira te alejarás, e inocente y justo no matarás, porque no justificaré a malo.
spanish: Desde palabra de mentira te alejarás, e inocente y justo no matarás, porque no justificaré al malo.
grammarChanges: Added the article required when "malo" functions as a substantivized noun direct object: "a malo" → "al malo". The Hebrew has no preposition and this adds no concept, matching the auditor's note.
readerNote: Added "al" (a + el) before "malo" because Spanish requires an article on a substantivized adjective used as a direct object; no concept is added beyond the Hebrew's generic sense.
